name: jc-pm-customer-service-prototype
description: Prototipo interactivo del espacio de trabajo de Atención al Cliente JC / PM (datos y acciones simulados).

scripts.build:single: tsc --noEmit -p . && vite build --base ./ --outDir dist-single && node scripts/inline-build.mjs dist-single JC-PM-Customer-Service-Demo.html
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:standalone: npm run build:single && DEMO_FILE=dist-single/JC-PM-Customer-Service-Demo.html playwright test tests/e2e/scenarios.spec.ts tests/e2e/meeting.spec.ts tests/e2e/standalone.spec.ts
